يلتقطون (form VIII)
# يَلْتَقِطُونَ (yaltaqiṭūna) /jal.ta.qi.tˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# يُلْتَقَطُونَ (yultaqaṭūna) /jul.ta.qa.tˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
